articles.title_en: The importance of the first generic substitution: Evidence from Sweden
articles.title_cn: 首次仿制药替代的重要性：来自瑞典的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze changes in the willingness to substitute from prescribed pharmaceuticals to more affordable generic equivalents in response to the first experience with a substitution. Using Swedish individual-level data of prescribed and dispensed pharmaceuticals, we employ a dynamic event study and an instrumental variable approach to show that an initial substitution reduces the probability of opposing subsequent substitutions by 39 percentage points. We recommend that policy-makers target patients with a history of opposed substitution and offer additional discounts to promote substitution as long-term savings outweigh one-time costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在首次经历替代后，患者从处方药转向更实惠的仿制药等效品的意愿变化。利用瑞典个体层面的处方和配药数据，我们采用动态事件研究和工具变量方法，表明首次替代将反对后续替代的概率降低了39个百分点。我们建议政策制定者针对有反对替代历史的患者，并提供额外折扣以促进替代，因为长期节省超过一次性成本。

articles.title_en: How far from the tree does the (good) apple fall? Spinout creation and the survival of high-tech firms
articles.title_cn: 好苹果离树有多远？衍生企业创建与高科技企业的生存
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model of spinout creation and survival to explain how the initial product market strategies of spinouts may differ with respect to their parent's and how this difference affects their success. We test the model using detailed information on all the entrants in three markets in the Local Area Networking (LAN) industry during the 1990s. Our findings are consistent with the implications of the theoretical model. Concerning spinout generation, the parent firm's technological know-how plays an important role for differentiation. In particular, we find that spinouts tend to imitate ‘average’ parents and ‘keep away from the extremes’ (i.e., parents whose know-how is ‘too close’ or ‘too distant’ with respect to the technological frontier). Concerning spinout survival, we find that more technologically advanced spinouts survive longer and that there is no direct effect of a parent's know-how on spinout's survival. Finally, too much differentiation with respect to the parent firm can be detrimental for spinout success.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个衍生企业创建与生存的模型，以解释衍生企业的初始产品市场策略如何可能与其母公司不同，以及这种差异如何影响其成功。我们利用局域网（LAN）行业三个市场中所有进入者的详细信息，在1990年代对模型进行了检验。我们的发现与理论模型的含义一致。关于衍生企业的产生，母公司的技术知识在差异化中起着重要作用。特别是，我们发现衍生企业倾向于模仿“平均”的母公司，并“远离极端”（即，那些技术知识相对于技术前沿“过近”或“过远”的母公司）。关于衍生企业的生存，我们发现技术更先进的衍生企业存活时间更长，且母公司的技术知识对衍生企业的生存没有直接影响。最后，与母公司相比，过度差异化可能对衍生企业的成功不利。

articles.title_en: A Baseline Model of Behavioral Political Cycles and Macroeconomic Fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 行为政治周期与宏观经济波动的基线模型
articles.abstract_en: Although the rational choice approach remains the theoretical modeling paradigm in economics and political sciences, the relevance of behavioral factors such as heuristics and biases has been increasingly acknowledged in both fields over the last decades. Against this background, and in honor the lifetime work of Peter Flaschel, we set up a baseline political-macroeconomic model of the Keynes-Metzler-Goodwin (KMG) variety enhanced with endogenous political choices as in Di Guilmi and Galanis (2021). The mutual feedback between the political and the macroeconomic spheres, generated by our framework, gives rise to cyclical dynamics around moving long-term trends for certain parameter constellations. The results of both the stability analysis and the simulations illustrate the existence of multiple political equilibria in the presence of endogenous electoral presences resulting from the crucial role of income distribution not only as a determinant of aggregate investment and aggregate output, but also, of the political climate.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管理性选择方法仍然是经济学和政治学中的理论建模范式，但在过去几十年中，启发式和偏见等行为因素的相关性在这两个领域都日益得到承认。在此背景下，为纪念Peter Flaschel的毕生工作，我们建立了一个凯恩斯-梅茨勒-古德温（KMG）类型的基线政治宏观经济模型，并按照Di Guilmi和Galanis（2021）的方法增强了内生政治选择。我们的框架所产生的政治与宏观经济领域之间的相互反馈，在特定参数组合下，围绕移动的长期趋势产生了周期性动态。稳定性分析和模拟的结果都表明，在存在内生选举压力的情况下，存在多重政治均衡，这源于收入分配的关键作用，它不仅决定了总投资和总产出，还决定了政治气候。

articles.title_en: Generalist CEO and carbon emissions
articles.title_cn: 通才CEO与碳排放
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we find a positive association between the general abilities of chief executive officers (CEOs) and the magnitude of carbon emissions in carbon-emitting firms (CEFs). Furthermore, generalist CEOs can reluctantly influence decisions on carbon emissions when CEFs’ transparency on environmental disclosure is poor, product market competition is intense, and investor myopia is prominent. Overall, our findings align with the notion that with higher job security, generalist CEOs may be willing to cannibalize their previously earned reputations for short-term gains and personal benefits. Our findings are robust to alternative measures of main variables and several endogeneity tests.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们发现首席执行官（CEO）的通用能力与碳排放企业（CEFs）的碳排放量之间存在正相关关系。此外，当CEFs的环境信息披露透明度较低、产品市场竞争激烈以及投资者短视现象突出时，通才CEO可能会不情愿地影响碳排放决策。总体而言，我们的研究结果与以下观点一致：在较高的工作保障下，通才CEO可能愿意为了短期收益和个人利益而牺牲他们先前赢得的声誉。我们的研究结果在主要变量的替代衡量标准和若干内生性检验中均保持稳健。

articles.title_en: Temporal discounting in later life
articles.title_cn: 晚年时间贴现
articles.abstract_en: We explore intertemporal decision-making in later life by looking at temporal preference heterogeneity among older individuals. Using choice tasks responses from Poland collected as part of the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), we elicit individual time preferences using competing discounting specifications. With the formulation that best fits our data, we examine which individual characteristics drive the estimated heterogeneity in later life time preferences. Individual numerical abilities, labour and marital status, as well as household income turn out to be significant correlates of patience. Our analysis also provides methodological guidance for instrument design with the aim of eliciting time preferences in a general survey setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察老年人之间的时间偏好异质性来探索晚年的跨期决策。利用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）中波兰部分的选择任务回答，我们使用竞争性的贴现规范来引出个体时间偏好。采用最适合我们数据的公式，我们检验了哪些个体特征驱动了晚年时间偏好的估计异质性。个体计算能力、劳动和婚姻状况以及家庭收入被证明是耐心的显著相关因素。我们的分析还为旨在在一般调查环境中引出时间偏好的工具设计提供了方法论指导。

articles.title_en: United States of Mind under Uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 不确定性下的美国心态
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates if heightened economic uncertainty raises concerns about mental health in the U.S. We first quantify such concerns by constructing a composite Mental Health Concerns index, using time series of the intensity of Google search queries related to mental disorders and distress. This index i) rises significantly during the three recessionary episodes and ii) comoves negatively with survey responses that reflect views on current consumer sentiment or on future economic conditions. We find that the concerns regarding mental health substantially increase after an unexpected hike in economic uncertainty; uncertainty not only channels through its negative impacts on economic activity, but also directly affects the level of concerns. Our findings suggest that an uncertainty shock can have a far-reaching impact on overall welfare of economic agents by leaving them more concerned about mental health.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了经济不确定性的加剧是否会引起美国民众对心理健康的担忧。我们首先通过构建一个综合的心理健康担忧指数来量化此类担忧，该指数使用了与精神障碍和困扰相关的谷歌搜索查询强度的时间序列。该指数在三次衰退期间显著上升，并与反映当前消费者情绪或未来经济状况看法的调查回答呈负相关。我们发现，在经济不确定性意外上升后，对心理健康的担忧大幅增加；不确定性不仅通过对经济活动的负面影响传导，还直接影响担忧水平。我们的研究结果表明，不确定性冲击可以通过让经济主体更加担忧心理健康，对其整体福利产生深远影响。

articles.title_en: Anger impairs strategic behavior: A Beauty-Contest based analysis
articles.title_cn: 愤怒损害策略行为：基于选美竞赛的分析
articles.abstract_en: The frustration-aggression hypothesis posits that anger affects economic behaviour essentially by temporally changing individual social preferences and specifically attitudes towards punishment. Here, we test a different channel in an experiment where we externally induce anger to a subgroup of participants (following a standard procedure that we verify by using a novel method of textual analysis). We show that anger can impair the capacity to think strategically in a beauty-contest game, in a pre-registered experiment. Angry participants choose numbers further away from the best response level and earn significantly lower profits. Using a finite mixture model, we show that anger increases the number of level-zero players by 9 percentage points, a percentage increase of more than 30%. Furthermore, with a second pre-registered experiment, we show that this effect is not common to all negative emotions. Sad participants do not play significantly further away from the best response level than the control group and sadness does not lead to more level-zero play.
articles.abstract_cn: 挫折-攻击假说认为，愤怒主要通过暂时改变个体的社会偏好，特别是对惩罚的态度，来影响经济行为。在这里，我们在一个实验中测试了另一种渠道，在该实验中，我们外部诱导一组参与者产生愤怒情绪（遵循一个标准程序，并通过一种新颖的文本分析方法进行验证）。我们在一项预注册实验中表明，愤怒会损害在选美竞赛游戏中策略性思考的能力。愤怒的参与者选择的数字偏离最佳反应水平更远，并且获得的利润显著更低。使用有限混合模型，我们表明愤怒使零级玩家的比例增加了9个百分点，百分比增幅超过30%。此外，通过第二个预注册实验，我们表明这种效应并非所有负面情绪所共有。悲伤的参与者与对照组相比，其选择并未显著偏离最佳反应水平，悲伤也不会导致更多的零级行为。

articles.title_en: Blockchain and the information – calculation problem
articles.title_cn: 区块链与信息—计算问题
articles.abstract_en: Ludwig von Mises produced an impossibility theorem indicating that economic calculation in the absence of market prices was impossible. This gave rise to the ‘socialist calculation debate’ in the first half of the twentieth century. This paper makes use of the insights of that debate to shed light on other situations where decision makers are required to allocate resources in areas where there are no market prices. A pertinent example would be most corporate social responsibility programs. In the absence of market prices local information cannot be communicated to decision makers. The paper further argues that blockchain technology can create the institutional environment for markets to emerge and consequently overcome the problem of missing prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 路德维希·冯·米塞斯提出了一个不可能性定理，表明在没有市场价格的情况下，经济计算是不可能的。这引发了二十世纪上半叶的“社会主义计算大辩论”。本文利用该辩论的见解，来阐明其他决策者在没有市场价格的领域分配资源的情况。一个相关的例子是大多数企业社会责任项目。在没有市场价格的情况下，本地信息无法传达给决策者。本文进一步认为，区块链技术可以为市场的出现创造制度环境，从而克服价格缺失的问题。

articles.title_en: Managerial human capital and corporate R&D investment
articles.title_cn: 管理人力资本与企业研发投资
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we employ firm-level panel data from China to study how the human capital characteristics of a firm's leadership affect R&D investment. One novel feature of this study is that we include human capital traits of both the CEO and the Board of Directors, as well as their interplay. Human capital is measured with various experiences to capture observed and unobserved traits. Using various econometric techniques, we find that both CEO's and BOD's human capital characteristics have a significant impact on R&D investment. CEOs’ innovation experience and overseas experiences promote innovation, while their production experience hinders it. The education and government experiences of board directors show different impacts on R&D investment. Moreover, the human capital traits of CEO and BOD influence each other and thus jointly affect innovation. The effects of leadership human capital on R&D investment are more profound in tech-intensive and smaller firms than in traditional or larger firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们利用中国公司层面的面板数据来研究公司领导层的人力资本特征如何影响研发投资。本研究的一个新颖之处在于，我们同时纳入了CEO和董事会的人力资本特征及其相互作用。人力资本通过多种经验来衡量，以捕捉可观测和不可观测的特征。使用各种计量经济学方法，我们发现CEO和董事会的人力资本特征对研发投资均有显著影响。CEO的创新经验和海外经验促进创新，而生产经验则阻碍创新。董事会成员的教育背景和政府工作经验对研发投资表现出不同的影响。此外，CEO和董事会的人力资本特征相互影响，从而共同影响创新。领导层人力资本对研发投资的影响在技术密集型和小型企业中比在传统或大型企业中更为显著。

articles.title_en: Sparking curiosity or tipping the scales? Targeted advertising with consumer learning
articles.title_cn: 激发好奇心还是打破平衡？消费者学习背景下的定向广告
articles.abstract_en: This paper argues, in the context of targeted advertising, that receivers’ ability to independently acquire information has a non-trivial impact on the sender’s optimal disclosure strategy. In our model, a monopolist has an opportunity to launch an advertising campaign and chooses a targeting strategy – which consumers to send its advertisement to. The consumers are uncertain about and heterogeneous in their valuations of the product, and can engage in costly learning about their true valuations. We discover that the firm generally prefers to target consumers who are either indifferent between ignoring and investigating the product, or between investigating and buying it unconditionally. If the firm is uncertain about the consumer appeal of its product, it targets these two distinct groups of consumers simultaneously but may ignore all consumers in between.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文认为，在定向广告的背景下，接收者独立获取信息的能力对发送者的最优披露策略具有非平凡的影响。在我们的模型中，垄断者有机会发起广告活动，并选择定向策略——即向哪些消费者发送广告。消费者对产品的估值存在不确定性且具有异质性，并且可以进行成本高昂的学习以了解其真实估值。我们发现，企业通常倾向于针对那些在产品忽视与调查之间无差异，或在调查与无条件购买之间无差异的消费者。如果企业对产品的消费者吸引力不确定，它会同时针对这两类不同的消费者群体，但可能会忽略介于两者之间的所有消费者。

articles.title_en: Ancestral diversity and performance: Evidence from football data
articles.title_cn: 祖先多样性与绩效：来自足球数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: The theoretical impact of diversity on performance is ambiguous since it leads to costs and benefits at the collective level. In this paper, we empirically assess the connection between ancestral diversity and the performance of sports teams. Focusing on football (soccer), we built a novel dataset of national teams of European countries that have participated in the European and World Championships since 1970. The ancestral diversity of national teams is measured from genetic distance scores within the team, based on information on every player's origins. Origins are recovered using a matching algorithm based on family names. Performance is measured at the match level. Identification of the causal link relies on an instrumental variable strategy based on past immigration at the country level about one generation before the competition. Our findings indicate a positive causal link between ancestral diversity and national teams' performance. We find that a one-standard increase in diversity leads to a significant increase in the goal difference of 0.77 to 1.79 goals per match (about a 1.30 goal difference per match).
articles.abstract_cn: 多样性对绩效的理论影响是模糊的，因为它在集体层面既带来成本也带来收益。在本文中，我们实证评估了祖先多样性与运动队绩效之间的联系。聚焦于足球，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，涵盖自1970年以来参加欧洲锦标赛和世界杯的欧洲国家队。国家队的祖先多样性通过队内遗传距离得分来衡量，该得分基于每位球员的起源信息。起源通过基于姓氏的匹配算法恢复。绩效在比赛层面衡量。因果联系的识别依赖于基于国家层面约一代人之前过去移民的工具变量策略。我们的研究结果表明，祖先多样性与国家队绩效之间存在正向因果联系。我们发现，多样性每增加一个标准差，会导致每场比赛净胜球显著增加0.77至1.79个（约每场比赛1.30个净胜球差异）。

articles.title_en: Meta-models of the Phillips curve and income distribution
articles.title_cn: 菲利普斯曲线与收入分配的元模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper reconsiders the flattening of the Phillips curve that has taken place over the last twenty-five years, together with the recent claim that a wage-price spiral could ignite an inflationary process. The two aspects are interrelated. The time-variation nature of the parameters plays a fundamental role in feeding a process of instability that may affect the reappearance of inflationary episodes. This paper first examines the extent of the U.S. Phillips curve flattening and nonlinearity by comparing the results of different econometric specifications and models. Based on these findings, the use of a regime-switching device, particularly studied by Richard Day, is proposed and applied to a Harrod–Minsky macro model. Three results are worth mentioning. The detection of nonlinearities in the U.S. Phillips curve leading to breaks in the curve; the ability of the model to generate robust bounded fluctuations, in which both Phillips curve loops and distributive loops can arise; the presence of both wage-led and profit-led distributive loops in the same model with different combinations of real and monetary parameters that can generate complex dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文重新审视了过去二十五年中菲利普斯曲线的平坦化现象，以及近期关于工资-价格螺旋可能引发通胀过程的说法。这两个方面是相互关联的。参数的时间变化性质在助长不稳定过程中起着根本性作用，这种不稳定可能影响通胀事件的再次出现。本文首先通过比较不同计量经济学设定和模型的结果，考察了美国菲利普斯曲线平坦化和非线性的程度。基于这些发现，本文提出并使用了一种由Richard Day特别研究的制度转换机制，并将其应用于Harrod–Minsky宏观模型。有三个结果值得提及：美国菲利普斯曲线中导致曲线断裂的非线性的检测；模型生成稳健有界波动的能力，其中菲利普斯曲线循环和分配循环都可能出现；在同一模型中，存在工资主导型和利润主导型分配循环，且不同的实际和货币参数组合可以产生复杂动态。

articles.title_en: Hidden costs of non-green performance? The impact of air pollution awareness on loan rates for Chinese firms
articles.title_cn: 非绿色绩效的隐性成本？空气污染意识对中国企业贷款利率的影响
articles.abstract_en: Given the idea that financial institutions can have a significant impact on environmental performance, green credit, which essentially involves capital allocation under environmental awareness, is worth to be explored and implemented by banking sectors worldwide. This paper explores the impact of environmental awareness on firms' loan rates, with a focus on borrowers who have a record of environmental penalties. Using a comprehensive loan dataset from one of China's “Big Five” banks between 2010 and 2013, we employ the volatility of particulate matter 2.5 (PM2.5) as a proxy to measure environmental awareness. Our findings suggest that the volatility of air pollution has a positive effect on the floating ratio of the loan interest rate for firms with a history of environmental penalties. Furthermore, we find that this mechanism is particularly pronounced for private-owned enterprises (POEs), new loan customers, firms with low crediting ratings, and small-sized enterprises. We also confirm the role of environmental awareness in firms' loan costs by demonstrating that the volatility of air pollution is sensitive to variations in insolation duration, environmental attention, and PM2.5 monitoring stations. We suggest that the volatility of air pollution is a more meaningful indicator than the degree of air pollution, and that people's voluntary environmental awareness can transfer the environmental risk of firms to their internal operating costs. The significance of this study lies in its potential to aid policymakers and investors in advancing sustainable finance practices, as well as stimulating individual engagement with environmental awareness and prompting financial institutions to give greater importance to these issues.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于金融机构对环境绩效可能产生重大影响的观点，绿色信贷本质上涉及环境意识下的资本配置，值得全球银行业探索和实施。本文探讨了环境意识对企业贷款利率的影响，重点关注有环境处罚记录的借款人。利用中国“五大”银行之一在2010至2013期间的全面贷款数据集，我们采用颗粒物2.5（PM2.5）的波动性作为衡量环境意识的代理变量。我们的研究结果表明，空气污染波动性对有环境处罚记录企业的贷款利率浮动比例有正向影响。此外，我们发现这种机制在民营企业（POEs）、新贷款客户、低信用评级企业和小型企业中尤为显著。我们还通过证明空气污染波动性对日照时长、环境关注度和PM2.5监测站点的变化敏感，确认了环境意识在企业贷款成本中的作用。我们认为，空气污染波动性比空气污染程度更有意义的指标，人们自愿的环境意识可以将企业的环境风险转移到其内部运营成本中。本研究的意义在于其可能有助于政策制定者和投资者推进可持续金融实践，同时激发个人参与环境意识，并促使金融机构更加重视这些问题。

articles.title_en: Arbitrageurs in the Bitcoin ecosystem: Evidence from user-level trading patterns in the Mt. Gox exchange platform
articles.title_cn: 比特币生态系统中的套利者：来自Mt. Gox交易平台用户级交易模式的证据
articles.abstract_en: We mine the leaked history of trades on Mt. Gox, the dominant Bitcoin exchange from 2011 to early 2014, in order to detect the triangular arbitrage conducted on the platform. To this end, we exploit user identifiers per trade to identify and describe the individual trading patterns of 440 arbitrageurs. Moreover, we introduce proxies for expertise and document that the expert users' distribution of profits first-order stochastically dominates that of non-expert users. Most importantly, by including user fixed effects, we show that expert users make profits on arbitrage by reacting quickly to plausible exogenous variations on the official exchange rates. A small number of expert arbitrageurs are able to conduct the vast majority of the arbitrage actions and systematically yield higher profits: our results provide empirical evidence that arbitrageurs are few and sophisticated users, characterized by the ability to incorporate information and to quickly react to exogenous shocks within short time scale intervals.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们挖掘了Mt. Gox（从2011到2014初期的领先比特币交易所）泄露的交易历史，以检测在该平台上进行的三角套利。为此，我们利用每笔交易的用户标识来识别和描述440个套利者的个体交易模式。此外，我们引入了专业知识的代理变量，并记录了专家用户的利润分布在随机占优意义上优于非专家用户。最重要的是，通过纳入用户固定效应，我们表明专家用户通过对官方汇率中可能的外生变化做出快速反应来从套利中获利。少数专家套利者能够执行绝大多数套利行为并系统性地获得更高利润：我们的结果提供了经验证据，表明套利者是少数且精明的用户，其特征是能够在短时间内整合信息并对冲击做出快速反应。

articles.title_en: Social learning in a network model of Covid-19
articles.title_cn: Covid-19网络模型中的社会学习
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of social learning on the transmission of Covid-19 in a network model. We calibrate our model to detailed data for Cape Town, South Africa and show that the inclusion of social learning improves the prediction of excess fatalities, reducing the best-fit squared difference from 19.34 to 11.40. The inclusion of social learning both flattens and shortens the curves for infections, hospitalizations, and excess fatalities, which is qualitatively different from flattening the curve by reducing the contact rate or transmission probability through non-pharmaceutical interventions. While social learning reduces infections, this alone is not sufficient to curb the spread of the virus because learning is slower than the rate at which the disease spreads. We use our model to study the efficacy of different vaccination strategies and find that vaccinating vulnerable groups first leads to a 72% reduction in fatalities and a 5% increase in total infections compared to a random-order benchmark. By contrast, using a contact-based vaccination strategy reduces infections by only 0.9% but results in 42% more fatalities than the benchmark.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了社会学习在Covid-19网络模型传播中的作用。我们将模型校准至南非开普敦的详细数据，并表明纳入社会学习能改善超额死亡人数的预测，使最佳拟合平方差从19.34降至11.40。社会学习的纳入既压平又缩短了感染、住院和超额死亡曲线，这与通过非药物干预降低接触率或传播概率来压平曲线在性质上不同。虽然社会学习减少了感染，但仅凭这一点不足以遏制病毒传播，因为学习速度慢于疾病传播速度。我们利用模型研究不同疫苗接种策略的效果，发现与随机顺序基准相比，优先为易感人群接种可使死亡人数减少72%，但总感染人数增加5%。相比之下，基于接触的疫苗接种策略仅使感染减少0.9%，但死亡人数比基准多42%。

articles.title_en: Delay Solow Model with a Normalized CES Production Function
articles.title_cn: 具有标准化CES生产函数的延迟索洛模型
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes the relationship between the elasticity of substitution and the economic stability/instability. To this end, we adopt a CES production function that consistently involves all its variants and introduce two delays, called a gestation delay and a depreciation delay, into the Solow model. In the case of one delay, we find that the gestation delay is harmless, the depreciation delay has a destabilizing effect, and the two delays having the equal length possesses a stronger stabilizing effect than the destabilizing effect of the depreciation delay. In the case of two different delays, we analytically construct the stability switching curve that divides the parametric region into the stability and instability regions. We also demonstrate that the location of the stability switching curve depends not only on the elasticity of substitution but the baseline values of the CES function and the parametric values of the dynamic equation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了替代弹性与经济稳定性/不稳定性之间的关系。为此，我们采用了一个一致包含其所有变体的CES生产函数，并在索洛模型中引入了两个延迟，称为孕育延迟和折旧延迟。在单一延迟的情况下，我们发现孕育延迟是无害的，折旧延迟具有不稳定性效应，而两个等长延迟的稳定效应强于折旧延迟的不稳定效应。在两个不同延迟的情况下，我们解析地构造了稳定性切换曲线，该曲线将参数区域划分为稳定区域和不稳定区域。我们还证明了稳定性切换曲线的位置不仅取决于替代弹性，还取决于CES函数的基线值和动态方程的参数值。

articles.title_en: The decline of trust across the U.S. finance industry
articles.title_cn: 美国金融业信任度的下降
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence on the evolution of generalized trust among finance professionals using data from the General Social Survey over the period 1978–2016. Accounting for demographic, regional, and socioeconomic characteristics, we document a significant decline in the level of trust among finance professionals relative to the decline of trust in the U.S. population. This decline is unique to the finance industry and is particularly strong in the early years of the sample when finance professionals initially exhibited a higher level of trust than the average American. The decline occurs across all subsectors in finance and at all hierarchy levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用1978-2016期间综合社会调查的数据，提供了金融专业人士普遍信任演变的证据。在考虑人口统计、地区和社会经济特征后，我们记录了金融专业人士信任水平的显著下降，相对于美国人口信任度的下降。这种下降是金融业特有的，并且在样本早期尤为明显，当时金融专业人士最初表现出高于普通美国人的信任水平。这种下降发生在金融业的所有子行业和所有层级。

articles.title_en: Sharing, social norms, and social distance: Experimental evidence from Russia and Western Alaska
articles.title_cn: 分享、社会规范与社会距离：来自俄罗斯和阿拉斯加西部的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how dictator giving varies by social context and worthiness of the recipient. We conduct lab-in-the-field experiments in Kamchatka, Russia, and Western Alaska, as well as a lab experiment with university students, in which we vary social distance and recipient characteristics across treatments. We ask what motivates individuals to share and whether offers from a dictator game, where dictators give from own-earnings, can tell us something more fundamental about social norms and sharing. Results indicate that subjects living in rural Indigenous communities, in both Russia and Alaska, who depend heavily on wild food harvests and possess strong sharing norms, are significantly more likely to give positive amounts compared to university students. We also find that in Indigenous communities, family relations and financial needs are prioritized in giving decisions. We suggest that treatment differences correspond to social norm differences in our study areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了独裁者给予如何随社会情境和受赠者的值得程度而变化。我们在俄罗斯堪察加半岛和阿拉斯加西部进行了实地实验，并对大学生进行了实验室实验，在不同处理中改变社会距离和受赠者特征。我们探究是什么动机促使个体分享，以及独裁者博弈中的出价（独裁者从自己的收入中给予）是否能告诉我们关于社会规范和分享的更基本的东西。结果表明，在俄罗斯和阿拉斯加，生活在农村原住民社区、严重依赖野生食物采集并拥有强烈分享规范的受试者，比大学生更有可能给予正数额。我们还发现，在原住民社区，家庭关系和财务需求在给予决策中被优先考虑。我们认为，处理差异对应于我们研究区域的社会规范差异。

articles.title_en: Is having an expert “friend” enough? An analysis of consumer switching behavior in mobile telephony
articles.title_cn: 拥有专家“朋友”就足够了吗？移动电话消费者转换行为分析
articles.abstract_en: We present novel evidence from a large panel of UK consumers who receive personalized reminders from a specialist price-comparison website about the precise amount they could save by switching to their best-suited alternative mobile telephony plan. We document three phenomena. First, even self-registered consumers with positive savings exhibit inertia. Second, we show that being informed about potential savings has a positive and significant effect on switching. Third, controlling for savings, the effect of incurring overage payments is significant and similar in magnitude to the effect of savings: paying an amount that exceeds the recurrent monthly fee weighs more on the switching decision than being informed that one can save that same amount by switching to a less inclusive plan. We interpret this asymmetric reaction on switching behavior as potential evidence of loss aversion. In other words, when facing complex and recurrent tariff plan choices, consumers care about savings but also seem to be willing to pay upfront fees in order to get “peace of mind”.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了来自英国消费者大型面板的新证据，这些消费者从专业价格比较网站收到个性化提醒，告知他们转换到最适合的替代移动电话套餐所能节省的确切金额。我们记录了三种现象。首先，即使是自我注册且具有正节省的消费者也表现出惯性。其次，我们表明，被告知潜在节省对转换行为有积极且显著的影响。第三，在控制节省的情况下，产生超额支付费用的影响显著且与节省的影响大小相似：支付超过经常性月费的金额比被告知可以通过转换到包含较少服务的套餐来节省相同金额更能影响转换决策。我们将这种转换行为的不对称反应解释为损失厌恶的潜在证据。换句话说，在面对复杂且经常性的资费套餐选择时，消费者关心节省，但似乎也愿意支付前期费用以获得“安心”。

articles.title_en: A model of voting with motivated beliefs
articles.title_cn: 具有动机信念的投票模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory in which heterogeneity in political preferences produces a partisan disagreement about objective facts. A political decision involving both idiosyncratic preferences and scientific knowledge is considered. Voters form motivated beliefs in order to improve their subjective anticipation of the future political outcome, which is determined by two-party competition à la Downs (1957). We provide conditions on preferences under which equilibrium beliefs are monotone along the political spectrum, as voters tend to deny the scientific arguments advocating the political orientations that run counter to their interests. Collective denial is the strongest in societies where contingent policy is the least likely to be implemented. Political competition does not imply policy convergence, as there exists an equilibrium in which each party targets a different group of voters as a function of their (endogenous) level of denial.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一个理论，其中政治偏好的异质性导致关于客观事实的党派分歧。考虑一个涉及个人偏好和科学知识的政治决策。选民形成动机信念，以改善他们对未来政治结果的主观预期，该结果由唐斯式（1957）的两党竞争决定。我们提供了偏好条件，在这些条件下，均衡信念沿着政治光谱是单调的，因为选民倾向于否认那些倡导与其利益相悖的政治取向的科学论点。在或有政策最不可能实施的社会中，集体否认最为强烈。政治竞争并不意味着政策趋同，因为存在一个均衡，其中每个政党针对不同的选民群体，作为其（内生的）否认水平的函数。

articles.title_en: Tuition too high? Blame competition
articles.title_cn: 学费太高？归咎于竞争
articles.abstract_en: In this article, we develop a feedback theory that includes reinforcing and balancing feedback effects that emerge when colleges compete for reputation, applicants, and tuition revenue. The feedback theory is replicated in a formal duopoly model consisting of two competing colleges. An independent ranking entity determines the relative order of the colleges. College applicants choose between the two colleges based on the rankings and the financial aid offered by the colleges. Contrary to the conventional wisdom that competition lowers prices and benefits consumers, our simulations show that competition between academic institutions for resources and reputation leads to tuition escalation that negatively affects students and their families. Four of the five scenarios – rankings, a capital campaign, facilities improvements, and an excellence campaign – increase college tuition, institutional debt, and expenditures per student; only the scenario of ignoring the rankings decreases these measures. By referring to the feedback structure of academic competition, the article makes several recommendations for controlling tuition inflation. This article contributes to the literature on the economics of higher education and illustrates the value of feedback economics in developing economic theory.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们发展了一个反馈理论，该理论包含了当大学争夺声誉、申请者和学费收入时出现的增强和平衡反馈效应。该反馈理论在一个由两所竞争大学组成的正式双头垄断模型中得到复制。一个独立的排名机构决定大学的相对顺序。大学申请者根据排名和大学提供的经济援助在两所大学之间进行选择。与传统观念认为竞争会降低价格并使消费者受益相反，我们的模拟表明，学术机构之间对资源和声誉的竞争导致学费上涨，这对学生及其家庭产生负面影响。五种情景中的四种——排名、资本运动、设施改善和卓越运动——增加了大学学费、机构债务和每名学生支出；只有忽略排名这一情景降低了这些指标。通过参考学术竞争的反馈结构，本文提出了控制学费通胀的若干建议。本文对高等教育经济学文献做出了贡献，并说明了反馈经济学在发展经济理论中的价值。

articles.title_en: Impacts of a mandatory shift to decentralized online auctions on revenue from public land leases in Ukraine
articles.title_cn: 强制转向分散式在线拍卖对乌克兰公共土地租赁收入的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the impact of a 2021 reform in Ukraine that—after earlier digitization efforts did not produce desired results—mandated use of transparent online auctions by local governments rather than a central agency to lease rights to public agricultural land. The shift to a collusion-proof electronic auction system increased lease revenue by 175% for our preferred specification. Had all public land that Ukraine transferred since 2015 been auctioned using post-reform mechanisms, local governments would receive incremental lease revenue of US$500 million per year for the duration of the lease. Where public land is important, reforms to ensure rights to such land are allocated transparently, competitively and in a decentralized way could improve social, economic, and environmental outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了乌克兰一项2021改革的影响——在早期数字化努力未产生预期效果后，该改革强制地方政府使用透明的在线拍卖而非中央机构来租赁公共农业用地。转向防勾结的电子拍卖系统使租赁收入增加了175%（根据我们偏好的规格）。如果乌克兰自2015以来转移的所有公共土地都采用改革后的机制进行拍卖，地方政府在租赁期内每年将获得额外租赁收入US$500百万。在公共土地重要的地方，确保此类土地权利以透明、竞争性和分散方式分配的改革可以改善社会、经济和环境成果。
